paragraphs: Phoenix Graphics Election Printing supplies ballot materials, election printing and fulfillment to election officials and boards of election. Pages for the company state that it supports 46 counties and nearly 13,000 election districts as the largest supplier of ballot materials in New York State. Services listed include early ballot layouts, certification updates, and MOVE Act file generation, alongside proprietary ballot layout software.

Election products described on the same page include voter information cards, secure envelopes, redistricting notices and polling place change notifications. Mailing work covers voter notifications, political mailings and outreach materials, with secure labeling, pre-printed shrink wrap and sealed cartons.

The about page states that the company holds two patents in ballot printing and proprietary ballot layout software. Both pages describe compliance with election laws and regulatory requirements as part of the work.

quote.text: For over 40 years, Phoenix Graphics Election Printing has been a trusted partner for election officials and boards of election.
